description:
## Sites
- apps/octo_pi_ai/lib/octo_pi/ai/message/user.ex
- apps/octo_pi_ai/lib/octo_pi/ai/message/tool_result.ex

## Change
User.t():
\`\`\`elixir
@type t :: %__MODULE__{
        content: String.t() | [Content.user_block()],   # <- drop String.t()
        timestamp: integer()
      }
\`\`\`
becomes:
\`\`\`elixir
@type t :: %__MODULE__{
        content: [Content.user_block()],
        timestamp: integer()
      }
\`\`\`

Same shape edit on ToolResult.t().content.

The moduledoc on user.ex currently says:
> \`content\` is either a plain string (shorthand for a single text
> block) or a list of text/image blocks.

Update to:
> \`content\` is a list of text/image blocks. Construct via
> \`OctoPi.Agent.Message.normalize/1\` if you have a plain string —
> it lifts strings into \`[%Text{text: ...}]\`.

## Tests
The dialyzer/typespec change has no runtime effect, but any test that
constructs \`%User{content: \"...\"}\` directly stops being shape-correct.
opi-5ka.1 already updated tests in octo_pi_agent to use list-shape
or normalize/1; this ticket extends the same pass through
octo_pi_coder, octo_pi_tui, and the AI provider apps.

Concrete test sites to revisit (~30 lines):
  apps/octo_pi_coder/test/octo_pi/coder/compaction/serialize_test.exs
  apps/octo_pi_coder/test/octo_pi/coder/compaction/tokens_test.exs
  apps/octo_pi_coder/test/octo_pi/coder/compaction/summary_test.exs
  apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/interactive_test.exs

Many of these tests are *intentionally* exercising the dual-shape;
they should be updated to use list-shape and the binary-shape
coverage moves to message_test.exs (opi-5ka.1) where the lift is
the contract under test.

## Depends on
opi-5ka.1 (normalize lifts) + opi-5ka.2 (set_messages plugged) so
no library code path can produce binary-shape content for these
types after this change lands.
title: Tighten User.t() / ToolResult.t() content type to list-only
